invariants.rationale: The method accesses tile.getProperties(), so tile must not be null.
tileElement is used for several getString and get calls, so it must not be null.
tile.getProperties() is used and passed to other methods, thus expected not to be null.
The "type" property is set in properties if and only if tileElement has a non-null "type" attribute.
The "terrain" property is set if and only if tileElement has a non-null "terrain" attribute.
